text:
tara-partners: Quick win shout — NimbleRx pushed us live on the AWS ISV Catalog today. Theyll offer Redwood Dedicated as a bundled option for their clinical NLP features. Huge conduit into the pharmacy vertical. :confetti_ball:

liam: Amazing! Any notes on contract length / committed spend?

tara-partners: 24-month commitment, initial Reserved nodes + opt-in for Private VPC in Q2. They'll list Redwood as recommended infra in the marketplace tile. Legal already cleared the listing copy.

nina-marketing: Love it. Can we get a short quote from Nimbles CTO about speed/ops? We'll draft a marketplace blurb and a LinkedIn announcement. Need logo permission + short customer quote by EOD Tue.

art-engineering: Congrats. For docs, we should provide a "Getting started" quickstart for marketplace customers that installs the Dedicated connector and a sample workload. I'll prep a sample terraform snippet and a minimal app example.

rachel-security: Heads up from security: marketplace customers that opt into Private VPC require SCIM + SSO config and a brief security questionnaire. We'll need to provide an ISV attestation doc. I'll share the template.

liam: Technical ask: can engineering produce a 2-line perf summary + one-liner about cost savings vs self-hosting? Marketing wants it for the tile.

art-engineering: Yep. Draft perf blurb: "Sub-50ms token latency at p95 for common inference paths on reserved g5 clusters; 30-40% unit cost reduction vs self-managed baseline with our batching + cache profiles." One-liner on costs: "Reserved Dedicated plans yield predictable per-token costs and simpler ops compared to do-it-yourself clusters."

nina-marketing: Perfect. Also need a tiny SDK snippet for the marketplace listing page (javascript). Prefer it to be <5 lines.

art-engineering: Draft snippet: ```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ key: 'REDACTED' });
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-chat-1', prompt: 'Extract meds from note' });
console.log(out.text);
```

tara-partners: Ops: deploy-bot created ticket ISV-4027 for post-listing telemetry hookup. Assign to @art-engineering for connector docs.

deploy-bot: Ticket ISV-4027 created and assigned to art-engineering. ETA 3d.

rachel-security: Please add the compliance pack (SOC2 summary + encryption controls) to the marketplace tile assets. I'll attach the files.
